title: Quarterly milestone sequencing and OKR mapping for enterprise private deployments
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Define a concrete, delivery-ready quarter plan that sequences features and operational work for enterprise private deployments (VPC and on-prem). This ticket consolidates milestone dates, owner assignments, OKR mappings, and cross-team dependencies so the Engineering, Console, and Security teams can align on commits and pre-release validation. Scope includes: rollout windows for private control plane, on-prem installer alpha, KMS/HSM integration work, RBAC/audit logging parity, and Dedicated compatibility validation. Out of scope: open-model catalog additions and hosted API pricing changes.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone plan with week-level deliverables published to Confluence and linked in this ticket
Owners assigned for each milestone and dependency (eng, infra, security, docs)
OKRs mapped: at least 2 measurable metrics tied to latency/cost/reliability outcomes for private customers
Cross-team dependency matrix created and triaged with engineering owners accepting the dates
Launch playbook skeleton (rollback, canary, customer communication) drafted and reviewed by Support and Sales
milestones: Week 2: Finalize installer alpha requirements and compatibility matrix
Week 4: KMS/HSM integration spike completed and security review scheduled
Week 6: Console RBAC + audit log parity MVP merged to staging
Week 8: Dedicated compatibility tests finished and performance regression baseline recorded
Week 11: Internal release candidate and runbook rehearsal
Week 12: Customer pilot onboarding window opens
risks: KMS/HSM integration may require vendor-specific adapters that increase implementation time
Installer packaging for air-gapped environments has unknown edge cases across customer infra
Performance regressions for on-prem quantized models could raise latency beyond SLA targets
Resource contention with Dedicated capacity roadmap (ENG-4290) during the same sprint window
decisions: Prioritize KMS/HSM integration + security review early in the quarter to avoid late blockers
Ship a staged alpha for on-prem installer (subset of features) rather than a feature-complete GA in this quarter
Map OKR metric OKR-DEPLOY-1 to 'pilot customers onboarded' and OKR-DEPLOY-2 to 'mean tail latency delta <= +10% vs hosted baseline'
